It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: a record they were supposed to destroy is still in their keeping and the person in front of them now resembles that old mistake. If that truth surfaces at Archive coffee mezzanine, Chicago, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
